newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals firm, low volumes for holiday season.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals firm, low volumes for holiday season.

text.p: Indian base metals' prices were steady on Monday on limited arrivals though industrial demand was low, dealers said.

Volumes were dull due to the Christmas holidays and major players kept away awaiting an announcement on selling prices of state-owned agencies for January. Ready copper was steady at 12,350 rupees, tin at 34,300 and nickel at 36,500. Last week copper, tin and nickel fell by 50, 100 and 200, respectively.

Aluminium was quiet at 7,250 rupees, zinc at 6,400 and lead at 4,450. "State-owned Hindustan Copper may cut selling prices for January or keep it unchanged," said Sharad Parikh, president of the Bombay Metal Exchange.
